title: Deliver dev.5 hierarchical Runs
goal: Ship a backward-compatible GraphSpec v2 and a bounded parent-child Run tree through the existing guarded Assignment loop.

prompt.objective: Add focused tests that define GraphSpec v2 prompt, Subgraph, hierarchy bound, and v1 compatibility behavior before implementation.
instructions: Keep the public envelope at schema version 1.
Test normalized v1 defaults and strict v2 rejection before mutating runtime state.
Use only deterministic project-local fixtures.
doneWhen: Known-valid v1 and v2 fixtures are explicit.
Invalid mode, child, route, depth, width, and ancestry inputs have stable expected errors.
The new contract tests fail against the dev.4 implementation for the intended reason.

prompt.objective: Create a copied dev.4 SQLite fixture and a projection oracle proving migration preserves all historical public facts while backfilling root hierarchy metadata.
instructions: Do not rewrite historical GraphSpec JSON, events, attempts, assignments, or revisions.
Seed a known-bad partial migration case that must roll back.
Keep raw runtime databases under ignored test temp paths.
doneWhen: Pre/post public projections are byte-equivalent where v1 exposed them.
Every old Run becomes its own depth-zero root with normal priority.
Migration is idempotent and a known-bad transaction leaves no partial schema data.

prompt.objective: Implement the smallest GraphSpec v2 and SQLite migration slice that makes the locked authoring and preservation oracles pass.
instructions: Normalize v1 without rewriting stored documents.
Use one migration ledger and one immediate transaction.
Replace root-only live uniqueness without weakening parent-child pinning.
doneWhen: v1 and v2 validate and persist as immutable revisions.
Hierarchy columns and link storage satisfy the migration oracle.
Focused authoring and migration tests pass.

prompt.objective: Add integration and CLI tests for static and dynamic children, replay, ancestor convergence, failure, cancellation, pause, resume, restart, and hierarchy bounds.
instructions: Drive only public service or CLI contracts.
Assert child-to-ancestor revision order and no duplicate child creation.
Keep lifecycle process safety compatible with future Gate execution.
doneWhen: A two-level tree has overlapping child work and converges.
Equivalent dynamic replay is inert and conflicting replay is rejected.
Pause, resume, cancellation, restart, and bounds have deterministic assertions.
The new tests fail against the pre-hierarchy runtime.

prompt.objective: Implement atomic static and dynamic Subgraph execution, hierarchy-aware scheduling, ancestor settlement, replay, and safe lifecycle propagation.
instructions: AI work remains reachable only through opaque Assignments.
One mutation settles descendants and ancestors atomically.
Never launch AI or identify processes by broad name.
doneWhen: Static and dynamic child sets start atomically.
Final child completion advances every legal ancestor before returning.
Scheduling and lifecycle operations respect the whole unfinished tree.
Focused hierarchy tests pass without regressing v1.

nodes.title: Expose bounded tree inspection and rendering

prompt.objective: Expose folded and depth-bounded tree snapshots through CLI, Mermaid, Viewer, SVG, and PNG from one canonical runtime projection.
instructions: Read-only commands must never mutate runtime state.
Refuse more than 500 rendered nodes with PROJECTION_LIMIT.
Preserve every v1 command and default projection.
doneWhen: Folded and expanded CLI and browser surfaces report identical totals.
Depth and node bounds are enforced.
A 256-Run folded and 500-node expanded core projection each finish under one second.

prompt.objective: Route pass only when UP06 and BDD S05 pass from source and isolated dev.5 package with migration, concurrency, projection, and regression evidence.
instructions: Run the complete applicable verification, not only focused tests.
Seed at least one known-bad migration or duplicate-child case and prove the Gate fails.
Choose repair for any unresolved product, migration, safety, or packaging blocker.
doneWhen: The route cites exact commands, counts, bounds, and artifact paths.
No unresolved blocker or unaccepted debt remains.
